1:24.sourceText: ἐγερθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος Κυρίου, καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ·
1:24.targetText: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.

groups.note: Actual raised-from-sleep participial expression becomes English temporal woke-up clause. Preserve actual waking predicate, from preposition and sleep noun; the initial δέ is not itself a when adverb.

studyHeads.note: Actual ἐγείρω passive waking/raising participle in the from-sleep construction.

1:25.sourceText: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως οὗ ἔτεκεν υἱόν· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
1:25.targetText: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.

groups.note: Actual third-person imperfect know predicate becomes the English had-union idiom, as the publisher’s literal footnote states. Actual γινώσκω remains a verb, without a separate union noun; actual οὐκ independently owns no.

studyHeads.note: Actual imperfect know predicate within the had-union rendering.
